source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Unit 7 (PDF 220-233), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 7 (Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line (TOC: 'Kinematics')) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define kinematics. Which tools of calculus does it use?
(Kinematics ki definition likhein. Yeh calculus ke kaun se auzaar (tools) istemal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinematics mechanics ki woh shaakh hai jo objects ki motion ko us ki wajah (cause) dekhe baghair bayan karti hai. Is mein differentiation (velocity aur acceleration, yani tabdeeli ki sharah) aur integration (acceleration se velocity, velocity se displacement) istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Kinematics is the branch of mechanics that describes the motion of objects without considering the causes of motion.

blocks.prompt:
2 Define rectilinear motion and give two examples.
(Rectilinear motion ki definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Particle ki seedhi line par motion ko rectilinear motion kehte hain. Misalein: seedhi sarak par car; upar neeche jaati lift; chhat se gira pathar.

book_ref.quote: The motion of a particle along a straight line is called rectilinear motion.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define a scalar quantity. Give two scalar quantities used in kinematics.
(Scalar quantity ki definition likhein. Kinematics ki do scalar quantities batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Scalar quantity sirf magnitude (miqdaar: number aur unit) se poori bayan hoti hai, direction (simt) nahin hoti. Misalein: distance (raaste ki kul lambai) aur speed (fi unit time distance).

book_ref.quote: Scalar quantities are those that are completely described by magnitude only

blocks.prompt:
4 Convert (i) \(90\) km/h into m/s (ii) \(12\) m/s into km/h.
(Tabdeel karein: (i) \(90\) km/h ko m/s mein (ii) \(12\) m/s ko km/h mein.)

book_ref.quote: Speed: Rate at which distance is covered per unit time, irrespective of direction.

blocks.prompt:
5 Define a vector quantity and name three vector quantities of kinematics.
(Vector quantity ki definition likhein aur kinematics ki teen vector quantities batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Vector quantity ki magnitude (miqdaar) aur direction (simt) dono hoti hain. Kinematics mein: displacement, velocity aur acceleration.

book_ref.quote: Vector quantities are described by both magnitude and direction.

blocks.prompt:
6 Distinguish between distance and displacement.
(Distance aur displacement mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Distance scalar hai (raaste ki lambai); displacement vector hai (position ki tabdeeli).

book_ref.quote: Change in position, from the initial to the final position

rows: Tay kiye gaye raaste ki kul lambai
Shuru se aakhri position tak tabdeeli
Sirf shuru aur aakhri position par munhasir
Positive, negative ya zero ho sakta hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Distinguish between speed and velocity.
(Speed aur velocity mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Speed scalar hai; velocity vector hai jis ki magnitude speed hai.

book_ref.quote: Its sign shows the direction of motion

rows: Is ka sign harkat ki direction batata hai

blocks.prompt:
8 A man walks \(8\) km north and then \(5\) km south along a straight road. Find the distance travelled and his displacement.
(Aik aadmi seedhi sarak par \(8\) km north aur phir \(5\) km south chalta hai. Distance aur displacement maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Distance \(= 8 + 5 = 13\) km. North positive: displacement \(= 8 - 5 = 3\) km north.

book_ref.quote: Displacement is change in position of a particle represented by a vector from initial to final position.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define average velocity and average speed.
(Average velocity aur average speed ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Average velocity \(= \dfrac{\text{total displacement}}{\text{total time}} = \dfrac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}\). Average speed \(= \dfrac{\text{total distance}}{\text{total time}}\).

book_ref.quote: defined as the total displacement divided by the total time taken

blocks.prompt:
10 A runner runs \(400\) m east in \(50\) s and then \(100\) m west in \(25\) s. Find his average speed and average velocity.
(Aik daurne wala \(50\) s mein \(400\) m east aur phir \(25\) s mein \(100\) m west daurta hai. Average speed aur average velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle kul distance aur kul time, phir signs ke saath displacement.

book_ref.quote: The average speed of an object is defined as the total distance travelled divided by the total time taken:

steps: Kul distance \(= 500\) m; kul time \(= 75\) s
East positive: displacement \(= 300\) m; average velocity \(= \frac{300}{75} = 4\) m/s
blocks.final_answer: Average speed \(\frac{20}{3} \approx 6.67\) m/s; average velocity \(4\) m/s east ki taraf.

blocks.prompt:
11 Define instantaneous velocity and instantaneous speed.
(Instantaneous velocity aur instantaneous speed ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Instantaneous velocity kisi lamhe par displacement ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli ka rate hai: \(v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}\). Instantaneous speed us ki magnitude hai: \(|v(t)|\).

book_ref.quote: is the rate of change of displacement with respect to time at a given instant

blocks.prompt:
12 The position of a particle is \(x(t) = t^{3} - 3t^{2} + 2\) (m, s). Find its velocity and acceleration at \(t = 3\) s.
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = t^{3} - 3t^{2} + 2\) (m, s) hai. \(t = 3\) s par velocity aur acceleration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Rate of change of velocity with respect to time is called acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
13 If \(x(t) = 5t - t^{2}\) (m, s), find the velocity and the speed at \(t = 4\) s.
(Agar \(x(t) = 5t - t^{2}\) (m, s) ho to \(t = 4\) s par velocity aur speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(v = 5 - 2t\), \(v(4) = -3\) m/s (negative direction mein); speed \(= 3\) m/s.

book_ref.quote: Instantaneous speed is the magnitude of instantaneous velocity

blocks.prompt:
14 A particle moves so that \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 15t^{2} + 36t\) (m, s). When is it momentarily at rest?
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 15t^{2} + 36t\) (m, s) hai. Yeh kab lamhaati taur par rest mein hota hai?)

book_ref.quote: momentarily at rest (this is where a particle can turn back)

blocks.prompt:
15 Prove that \(a = v\dfrac{dv}{dx}\) when the velocity \(v\) is given as a function of the displacement \(x\).
(Saabit karein ke jab velocity \(v\) displacement \(x\) ka function ho to \(a = v\dfrac{dv}{dx}\).)
blocks.explanation: Chain rule \(x\) ke zariye lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The chain rule lets us go

blocks.prompt:
16 The velocity of a particle is \(v = x^{2} + 1\) (\(v\) in m/s, \(x\) in m). Find its acceleration when \(x = 2\) m.
(Particle ki velocity \(v = x^{2} + 1\) hai (\(v\) m/s, \(x\) m). \(x = 2\) m par acceleration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: of the particle is given as a function of displacement

blocks.prompt:
17 The position of a particle is \(x(t) = 3\cos t\). Find its velocity and acceleration at \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = 3\cos t\) hai. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity aur acceleration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(v = -3\sin t\), \(v\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = -3\). \(a = -3\cos t\), \(a\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0\).

book_ref.quote: Find the velocity and the speed of the particle at any time

blocks.prompt:
18 What does the slope of a displacement-time graph represent? What do a rising, a horizontal and a falling straight line show?
(Displacement-time graph ka slope kya zahir karta hai? Upar jaati, horizontal aur neeche aati seedhi line kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{dx}{dt} =\) velocity. Upar jaati line: constant \(v > 0\) (aage); horizontal: \(v = 0\) (rest); neeche aati line: constant \(v < 0\) (ulti simt).

book_ref.quote: represents velocity of the particle.

blocks.prompt:
19 A displacement-time graph is a straight line from \((0, 10)\) to \((5, 35)\) (\(t\) in s, \(x\) in m). Find the velocity.
(Displacement-time graph \((0, 10)\) se \((5, 35)\) tak seedhi line hai (\(t\) s, \(x\) m). Velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Velocity \(=\) slope \(= \frac{35 - 10}{5} = 5\) m/s.

book_ref.quote: If velocity is uniform i.e.,

blocks.prompt:
20 A walker's displacement-time graph joins \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(30, 2)\), \(B(40, 2)\), \(C(60, 0)\) (\(t\) in minutes, \(x\) in km). Find the velocity on each stage in km/h.
(Aik paidal chalne wale ka displacement-time graph \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(30, 2)\), \(B(40, 2)\), \(C(60, 0)\) ko jorta hai (\(t\) minutes, \(x\) km). Har hisse par velocity km/h mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ka slope km/min mein, phir 60 se zarb.

book_ref.quote: Average velocity over an interval = change in

blocks.final_answer: OA \(4\) km/h, AB \(0\) km/h, BC \(-6\) km/h (wapsi).

blocks.prompt:
21 For the same walker (\(O(0, 0)\), \(A(30, 2)\), \(B(40, 2)\), \(C(60, 0)\); minutes, km), find the average speed and the average velocity for the whole journey.
(Usi paidal chalne wale (\(O(0, 0)\), \(A(30, 2)\), \(B(40, 2)\), \(C(60, 0)\); minutes, km) ki poore safar ki average speed aur average velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Distance \(= 4\) km, time \(= 1\) h (rukna shamil): average speed \(= 4\) km/h. Woh wapas shuru par, displacement \(= 0\), average velocity \(= 0\).

book_ref.quote: Waiting time counts in the total time of a journey.

blocks.prompt:
22 A van drives for \(1.5\) h at an average velocity of \(60\) km/h, stops for \(0.5\) h, and then drives a further \(30\) km in the same direction in \(1\) h. Find its total displacement and its average velocity.
(Aik van \(1.5\) h \(60\) km/h ki average velocity se chalti hai, \(0.5\) h rukti hai, phir usi simt mein \(1\) h mein mazeed \(30\) km chalti hai. Kul displacement aur average velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehli drive \(= 90\) km; kul displacement \(= 120\) km; kul time \(= 3\) h (rukna shamil); average velocity \(= 40\) km/h.

book_ref.quote: the particle is moving with positive uniform velocity from point

blocks.prompt:
23 What do the slope and the area under a velocity-time graph represent?
(Velocity-time graph ka slope aur us ke neeche ka area kya zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{dv}{dt} =\) acceleration. \(t_{1}\) se \(t_{2}\) tak area \(= \int_{t_{1}}^{t_{2}} v\,dt =\) us waqfe mein displacement.

book_ref.quote: Acceleration = Slope of velocity time graph

blocks.prompt:
24 Show that the area under a velocity-time graph from \(t = t_{1}\) to \(t = t_{2}\) is the displacement in that interval.
(Dikhayein ke velocity-time graph ke neeche \(t_{1}\) se \(t_{2}\) tak ka area us waqfe ka displacement hai.)
blocks.explanation: Area ko integral ki shakal mein likh kar \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: then from integral calculus:

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: area \(A = x(t_{2}) - x(t_{1})\), yani \(t_{1}\) se \(t_{2}\) tak displacement.

blocks.prompt:
25 A particle starts from rest and reaches \(12\) m/s uniformly in \(3\) s, keeps this velocity up to \(t = 10\) s and then comes to rest uniformly at \(t = 12\) s. Find its acceleration in the first \(3\) s and the total displacement.
(Particle rest se \(3\) s mein yaksaan \(12\) m/s tak pohanchta hai, \(t = 10\) s tak yehi velocity rakhta hai, phir \(t = 12\) s par yaksaan ruk jaata hai. Pehle \(3\) s ki acceleration aur kul displacement nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration \(= \frac{12}{3} = 4\) m/s\(^{2}\). Displacement \(=\) trapezium ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}(12 + 7)(12) = 114\) m.

book_ref.quote: If \(a = \frac{dv}{dt} = \text{constant} > 0\)

blocks.prompt:
26 The velocity of a particle falls uniformly from \(9\) m/s at \(t = 0\) to \(-6\) m/s at \(t = 5\) s. Find its displacement and the distance travelled in these \(5\) s.
(Particle ki velocity \(t = 0\) par \(9\) m/s se \(t = 5\) s par \(-6\) m/s tak yaksaan kam hoti hai. In \(5\) s mein displacement aur distance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle dekhein graph time axis ko kahan kaat'ta hai, phir do triangles ke area.

book_ref.quote: Remember that \(A_{1}\) and \(A_{2}\) are both taken as positive numbers here.

blocks.prompt:
27 The velocity of a particle is \(v(t) = 4t - t^{2}\) m/s for \(0 \le t \le 4\). Find its displacement in this interval.
(Particle ki velocity \(0 \le t \le 4\) ke liye \(v(t) = 4t - t^{2}\) m/s hai. Is waqfe mein displacement nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Thus, \(A\) = displacement

blocks.prompt:
28 Derive \(v = u + at\) for a particle moving with constant acceleration \(a\) and initial velocity \(u\).
(Constant acceleration \(a\) aur shuru ki velocity \(u\) wale particle ke liye \(v = u + at\) derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{dv}{dt} = a\) ko integrate karein aur \(t = 0\) par \(v = u\) se constant nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Using the initial condition \(v = u\) at \(t = 0\), substitute into equation (1):

blocks.prompt:
29 Derive \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\), taking \(x = 0\) at \(t = 0\).
(\(t = 0\) par \(x = 0\) le kar \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{dx}{dt} = u + at\) ko integrate karein aur constant nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Using the initial condition \(x = 0\) at \(t = 0\), substitute into equation (3):

blocks.prompt:
30 A bus speeds up uniformly from \(5\) m/s to \(20\) m/s in \(10\) s. Find its acceleration and the distance covered.
(Bus \(10\) s mein \(5\) m/s se \(20\) m/s tak yaksaan tez hoti hai. Acceleration aur tay kiya faasla nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: These equations are frequently used to describe and analyze the motion of a particle under constant acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
31 A car moving at \(30\) m/s brakes with a uniform retardation of \(5\) m/s\(^{2}\). Find the time it takes to stop and the stopping distance.
(\(30\) m/s se chalti car \(5\) m/s\(^{2}\) ki yaksaan retardation se brake lagati hai. Rukne ka waqt aur faasla nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Choose the equation that leaves out the quantity which is neither given nor asked.

blocks.prompt:
32 A car starts from rest and covers \(100\) m in \(10\) s with uniform acceleration. Find the acceleration and the velocity at the end.
(Car rest se chal kar yaksaan acceleration se \(10\) s mein \(100\) m tay karti hai. Acceleration aur aakhri velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: "Starts from rest" means \(u = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
33 A particle has acceleration \(a(t) = 2 + 6t\) m/s\(^{2}\) and velocity \(3\) m/s at \(t = 0\). Find \(v(t)\) and \(v(2)\).
(Particle ki acceleration \(a(t) = 2 + 6t\) m/s\(^{2}\) aur \(t = 0\) par velocity \(3\) m/s hai. \(v(t)\) aur \(v(2)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: fixing each constant from an initial condition

blocks.prompt:
34 The velocity of a particle is \(v(t) = 3t^{2} - 2t\) m/s and it is at \(x = 4\) m when \(t = 0\). Find \(x(t)\) and \(x(2)\).
(Particle ki velocity \(v(t) = 3t^{2} - 2t\) m/s hai aur \(t = 0\) par \(x = 4\) m. \(x(t)\) aur \(x(2)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: integrate \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\) to get \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
35 A particle starts from the origin with velocity \(1\) m/s and has acceleration \(a(t) = \cos t\). Find \(v(t)\) and \(x(t)\).
(Particle origin se \(1\) m/s velocity ke saath chalta hai aur acceleration \(a(t) = \cos t\) hai. \(v(t)\) aur \(x(t)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa integrate karein, har constant nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Recall \(\int \cos t\,dt = \sin t\) and \(\int \sin t\,dt = -\cos t\).

blocks.prompt:
36 A particle starts from rest at the origin with acceleration \(a(t) = 12t^{2}\). Find its position at \(t = 2\) s.
(Particle origin par rest se chalta hai aur acceleration \(a(t) = 12t^{2}\) hai. \(t = 2\) s par position nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For variable acceleration integrate:

blocks.text: 7.1.7 Motion of a Free Particle Moving Along a Vertical Line

blocks.prompt:
37 What is free fall? Which equations of motion are used for upward and for downward motion?
(Free fall kya hai? Upar aur neeche ki harkat ke liye kaun si equations of motion istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf gravity ke asar mein, hawa ki rukawat nazar-andaz, vertical line par harkat. Neeche: \(a = g\); upar: \(a = -g\); \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\).

book_ref.quote: the motion is called free fall or free vertical motion

blocks.prompt:
38 A stone is dropped from a height of \(122.5\) m. Find the time to reach the ground and the velocity on impact.
(Pathar \(122.5\) m ki unchai se giraya jaata hai. Zameen tak waqt aur takrane par velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: (Free Fall from Rest) A stone is dropped from the top of a tower

blocks.prompt:
39 A ball is thrown vertically upward with \(24.5\) m/s. Find the time to reach the top and the maximum height.
(Gend \(24.5\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai. Top tak waqt aur maximum height nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Time to the top \(= \frac{u}{g}\); maximum height \(= \frac{u^{2}}{2g}\).

blocks.prompt:
40 A particle is projected vertically upward with velocity \(u\). Show that the time to reach the highest point is \(\frac{u}{g}\) and the maximum height is \(\frac{u^{2}}{2g}\).
(Particle velocity \(u\) se seedha upar phenka jaata hai. Dikhayein ke top tak waqt \(\frac{u}{g}\) aur maximum height \(\frac{u^{2}}{2g}\) hai.)
blocks.explanation: Top par \(v = 0\); \(a = -g\) wali equations lagayein.

book_ref.quote: If a particle is projected upward, its velocity decreases uniformly due to gravity

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: top tak waqt \(\frac{u}{g}\), maximum height \(\frac{u^{2}}{2g}\).

blocks.prompt:
41 A ball is thrown vertically downward with \(5\) m/s from a bridge and hits the water \(2\) s later. Find the height of the bridge and the velocity on hitting the water.
(Pul se gend \(5\) m/s se seedhi neeche phenki jaati hai aur \(2\) s baad paani se takraati hai. Pul ki unchai aur takrane par velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: it accelerates toward the ground at the rate

blocks.prompt:
42 A ball is thrown vertically upward with \(9.8\) m/s. Find its velocity and its height above the point of projection after \(1.5\) s.
(Gend \(9.8\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai. \(1.5\) s baad velocity aur phenkne ki jagah se unchai nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Thinking the acceleration is zero at the highest point
